claim_candidates.subject: machine-tool installed capacity
claim_candidates.text: Jyoti CNC is reported with 6,000 machines/year installed capacity in India and 121 in France.
caveat: Installed capacity is not operating good qualified output.
unknowns: Current utilization, yield, product mix, and approval scope are UNKNOWN.
claim_candidates.escalation: Reconcile each site and year against filings, commissioning, run-at-rate, and qualification records.

claim_candidates.subject: domestic CNC coverage
claim_candidates.text: The memo reports approximately 35% domestic supply coverage and 65% import dependence for CNC machine demand.
caveat: Market coverage and trade share are not physical qualified capacity.
unknowns: Denominator, product mix, and current-year methodology are UNKNOWN.
conflicts: Coverage figures may conflict with other market estimates.
claim_candidates.escalation: Obtain a dated production/shipments series with explicit denominator and model mix.

claim_candidates.subject: metrology laboratory count
claim_candidates.text: NABL is reported with approximately 1,208 accredited calibration laboratories as of early 2024.
caveat: Accreditation is eligibility and infrastructure, not product-specific qualified industrial supply.
unknowns: Scope by dimensional capability and active validity is UNKNOWN.
claim_candidates.escalation: Request current accreditation scopes, validity, equipment, measurement uncertainty, and available slots.

claim_candidates.subject: Bharat CNC status
claim_candidates.text: Bharat CNC is described as a government-backed controller project in testing and early adoption.
caveat: Project/testing status is not commercially qualified production.
unknowns: OEM adoption, reliability, export eligibility, and current production volume are UNKNOWN.
conflicts: CMTI testing claims and OEM adoption signals may diverge.
claim_candidates.escalation: Collect versioned test reports, production units, customer acceptance, and field-return evidence.

claim_candidates.subject: bearing throughput
claim_candidates.text: NEI/NBC is reported with throughput above 200 million bearings per year across many variants.
caveat: Gross or reported throughput does not establish grade-specific good qualified output.
unknowns: Current yield, grade mix, aerospace/defence qualification, and free capacity are UNKNOWN.
claim_candidates.escalation: Request site-, grade-, and customer-specific run-at-rate and qualification records.

claim_candidates.subject: Jyoti ball-screw expansion
claim_candidates.text: The memo reports a Jyoti CNC expansion toward 16,000 machines/year and a captive high-speed ball-screw line.
caveat: Expansion/nameplate is not commissioned effective capacity or qualified ball-screw output.
unknowns: Commissioning, utilization, grade, and customer acceptance are UNKNOWN.
claim_candidates.escalation: Verify project milestone, equipment acceptance, line yield, and part qualification.

claim_candidates.subject: rare-earth pilot plant
claim_candidates.text: ARCI Hyderabad is associated with an Nd-Fe-B rare-earth permanent-magnet pilot plant.
caveat: Pilot-plant establishment does not prove scaled operating magnet output.
unknowns: Current throughput, composition, coercivity, yield, and customer qualification are UNKNOWN.
claim_candidates.escalation: Obtain current production logs, test certificates, and customer/grade qualification.

claim_candidates.subject: semiconductor fab project
claim_candidates.text: Tata Electronics and PSMC are associated with a Dholera semiconductor-fab technology-transfer project.
caveat: Announcement and site/project presence are not operating wafer capacity.
unknowns: Construction, tool install, yield, product mix, and qualification are UNKNOWN.
claim_candidates.escalation: Verify construction/commissioning milestones and audited wafer output by process node.

claim_candidates.subject: semiconductor ATMP facility
claim_candidates.text: Micron is associated with an India semiconductor assembly-and-test facility in Sanand.
caveat: Facility opening or presence is not good qualified ATMP output.
unknowns: Current package types, yield, utilization, customer qualification, and available capacity are UNKNOWN.
claim_candidates.escalation: Request dated production, yield, customer qualification, and utilization evidence.

claim_candidates.subject: nuclear operating and pipeline totals
claim_candidates.text: The memo separates approximately 8,880 MW operating nuclear capacity from 12,200 MW pipeline and a 7,000 MW fleet-mode target.
caveat: Operating generation, pipeline projects, and scenario targets are distinct states.
unknowns: Project-level operating status, commissioning dates, and equipment supply capability are UNKNOWN.
conflicts: Headline totals may use different boundary definitions.
claim_candidates.escalation: Reconcile plant-level status, boundary, date, and supplier qualification before modeling capacity.

claim_candidates.subject: future-dated project targets
claim_candidates.text: Cross-cutting project claims include future/current-state targets for semiconductors, batteries, solar, magnets, aerospace, defence, and nuclear.
caveat: Future targets are scenarios or plans, not current operating output.
unknowns: Milestones, financing, construction, commissioning, and qualified output are UNKNOWN.
claim_candidates.escalation: Revalidate each project against dated primary releases and site evidence at decision time.

claim_candidates.subject: source URL wrapper anomaly
claim_candidates.text: Ninety source-index URL tokens contain a malformed markdown-wrapper suffix; the underlying token is retained for reversible repair.
caveat: URL-token cleanup is a conditioning repair/escalation, not corroboration.
unknowns: Exact intended URL and page version require source-owner verification for affected rows.
claim_candidates.escalation: Run deterministic URL-token repair and revalidate each source before promotion.
